name: bazario
description: Bazario: an Amazon.com-style store (take-home). Modular NestJS API + Next.js web.

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --wait && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && cp -n api/.env.example api/.env; cp -n web/.env.example web/.env.local; npm --prefix api run db:migrate && npm --prefix api run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
